records.variant_policy: Unlisted regions reuse the common functional substrate through their bespoke kit; add a new regional variant only when ecology, process or structure changes. Regional descriptions are design proposals, not claims about details visible in reference art.
collision: Surface tag authored separately from shader; displacement cannot open collision gaps.
Movement/nav, hit detection, interaction and hazard volumes remain separate; visual LOD never changes authority.
animation: Static substrate by default.
Distant cosmetics may pause or simplify; authoritative state and readable hazard tell persist.
lod: Near detail / gameplay silhouette / far mass variants where meaningful; preserve landmarks, sockets and safe-route cues.
Choose screen-space thresholds and hysteresis using representative-camera tests; no fixed performance claims.
Stream collision/nav/essential cues before detail; unloaded cosmetic variants use a stable safe fallback.
interactions: Material interaction tags preserve source castable contracts and ownership bounds.
State ownership and bounded tags use foundation interaction contracts; no alteration of source castable behavior.

performance.acceptance: Record CPU/GPU frame-time distribution, resident bytes, draw/material counts and transition stalls on selected target hardware at fixed camera/build/revision. No benchmark or budget compliance is asserted.
performance.fallback: Reduce decoration, distant animation and shadow/transparency quality before critical geometry, exit signs or hazard cues.
